description: This PHP source file defines the 'ImapHandlerFactory' class, responsible for creating and managing instances of IMAP handlers, including test mode configurations, and external dependencies related to IMAP handling within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing IMAP handler instances, supporting test configurations, handler availability checks, and encapsulating handler logic.

methods.name: setInterfaceObject
methods.description: Assigns a specific IMAP handler object to be used by the factory.

methods.name: includeFakeInterface
methods.description: Includes the fake IMAP handler class if not already loaded.

methods.name: loadTestSettings
methods.description: Loads specified test settings and prepares a fake IMAP handler for testing environments.

methods.name: getTestSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the current test settings key from a file or defaults.

methods.name: deleteTestSettings
methods.description: Deletes the test settings configuration file.

methods.name: saveTestSettingsKey
methods.description: Saves a provided test settings key to a file after validation.

methods.name: getImapHandler
methods.description: Returns an IMAP handler instance, either real or test mode based on configuration.

methods.name: areAllHandlersAvailable
methods.description: Checks if all available IMAP handlers are functional and available.

methods.name: getHandlerClass
methods.description: Determines the handler class name based on handler type parameter.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Provides a list of available handler types and corresponding class names.
